title: The Andelys Crematorium welcomes families during Remembrance Day with a record 890 cremations
text: The Andelys Crematorium welcomes families during Remembrance Day with a record 890 cremations The Andelys Crematorium reports a successful year with nearly 900 cremations in 2025. The annual Remembrance Day on October 31st will provide families with a space to honor their loved ones through ceremony and community. The report also highlights the changing trends in the disposal of ashes, with a significant shift towards scattering. Before the Saturday October 31st Remembrance Day, the Andelys Crematorium reports on its activities. In 2025, the facility performed 890 cremations, an increase from 860 in 2024. As every year since its opening, the Andelys Crematorium team (Eure) will welcome grieving families during the Remembrance Day on Saturday October 31, 2026. The number of cremations approached 900 in 2025. The annual activity report, required by the service concession contract for the creation and management of the crematorium and the adjacent cemetery site, was presented a few weeks ago to the city council.Activité et chiffres de l'Andelys CrematoriumThe year 2025 started off with a bang, with January and February being the most productive months, totaling 188 cremations (96 in January and 92 in February), averaging nearly five per day from Monday to Friday. Conversely, the period of lowest activity was in the spring, with 63 cremations in April and 65 in May. The city hall's civil registry service processed 121 cremation requests.The crematorium's influence extends beyond departmental borders, notably towards Normandie and the Paris region, with 80 families from the Île-de-France region. The fate of the ashes reveals a balance between burial, which remains the majority at 49%, and scattering, which is narrowing the gap at 46%. This difference indicates a clear trend among families towards more diverse and personalized methods for the final resting place of ashes. The 5th Remembrance Day is scheduled for Saturday, October 31, 2026.Journée du souvenir le 31 octobre 2026The format changes each year, but the principle of the Remembrance Day organized by the Andelys Crematorium remains the same: to provide an opportunity for grieving families to gather and remember their loved ones. It is intended to be a moment of both emotion and joy. With All Saints Day falling on a Sunday, the event will be held on Saturday, October 31, 2026. Families will be welcomed at the crematorium starting at 10 am.The ceremony will feature readings and musical entertainment by the duo, followed by a moment of sharing and conviviality at 12:30 pm. The afternoon will be dedicated to a tour of the technical facilities from 2 to 4 pm, where participants can learn about the crematorium's operations. In Seine-Saint-Denis, Bally Bagayoko is advocating for the cessation of intermediate housing to produce ultra-social housing.The French Canon is contesting a 45,000 euro bill for its banquet in Biarritz; the prefect explains and justifies the invoice.
summary: The annual Remembrance Day on October 31st will provide families with a space to honor their loved ones through ceremony and community. As every year since its opening, the Andelys Crematorium team (Eure) will welcome grieving families during the Remembrance Day on Saturday October 31, 2026. This difference indicates a clear trend among families towards more diverse and personalized methods for the final resting place of ashes.
